answer: A farm of 361 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in forge, queued in whisper, and zenith publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 49 identities per epoch. A farm of 3598 identities would post 2350 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
